versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill to salesman-recommender-CN, updating all documentation to Chinese.
- Removed the English skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functional code or logic.

Initial release of salesman-recommender – v1.0.0

- Automatically filters influencers from Jingxuan Alliance Influencer Plaza based on user-defined criteria.
- Supports exporting filtered influencer data to an Excel file on the desktop.
- Allows filtering by category, sales data, follower counts, influencer level, and gender.
- Includes auto-login logic with support for manual or credential-based login and recruiter role selection.
- Handles login flow, error scenarios, and network timeouts for robust operation.

Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of salesman-recommender.
- Automates filtering of livestream influencers based on customizable conditions from the selected alliance platform.
- Exports influencer data to an Excel file on the desktop.
